name: Mona
_curatorNotes: Hexerei layer authored 2026-07-29. gcsim mona/mona.go:38-43 — IsHexerei defaults to enabled, so a bare `IsHexerei` check is a PERMANENT kit patch and only `GetHexereiCount() >= 2` is Secret-Rite (count-gated).

COUNT-GATED (Secret Rite, gcsim asc.go:86-198): both pieces are unauthorable, so `factionBonuses` is intentionally absent (CharacterData JSDoc: 'Empty/absent on characters with no contributing effects'). (a) astralGlowGainCB (asc.go:86-105, wired on attack.go:59 and charge.go:67) — N/CA hits grant Astral Glow of Mercury stacks (0.1s ICD, max 3, 8s lifetime); hexInit (asc.go:158-181) gives every OTHER party member a ReactBonusMod of +5% Vaporize DMG per stack, consuming all stacks on trigger. No vaporize-DMG-bonus stat exists and reaction-DMG derivation is FROZEN (caveat-style-guide § FROZEN), so this is caveated on the normal-attack ability, not modeled. (b) omenRefreshCB (asc.go:110-156) — N/CA hits on an Omen-affected foe extend Omen by 2s (0.5s ICD), up to 4 refreshes = +8s; burst.go:149-151 seeds that budget (`SetTag(omenKey, 4)` under a bare IsHexerei check). `durationExtensions` on onHit is on the CANNOT list, so this is caveated too.

PERMANENT PATCHES (bare IsHexerei): C1 off-field 160% reaction bonus (cons.go:63-68), C2 party-wide +80 EM on CA hit (cons.go:133-160) and the guaranteed post-burst CA window (burst.go:61-63 + cons.go:120-126), C4 +15% CRIT DMG for Hexerei members (cons.go:180-183, 227-229), C6 doubled CA multiplier vs Omen/Bubble targets and the off-field nearby-Omen stack ticker (cons.go:260-283, 324-352). Only the C2 EM buff and the C4 CRIT DMG buff are stat buffs; the rest are damage multipliers or proc machinery.

Reviewer to decide whether to record post-windup values (swap=40, E=78, Q=54, D=58, J=50 from normals) or keep raw.
N4 has ActionCharge=500 in gcsim, marked as 'TODO: this action is illegal' — omitted from frames.
No plunge.go found in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.

Hexerei Secret Rite (count-gated, >=2 Hexerei) rides on N and CA hits: astralGlowGainCB + omenRefreshCB are attached to the normal-attack queue (gcsim attack.go:59-60) and the charged-attack queue (charge.go:67-68). Neither is authorable — see the top-level Hexerei note. Caveated here because both are player-decision-relevant (they change how much N/CA weaving is worth in a Hexerei party).
abilities.caveat: With two or more Hexerei in the party, Normal and Charged hits build Astral Glow of Mercury stacks that boost teammates' Vaporize DMG, and extend an enemy's Omen by up to 8s. Neither is modeled.

abilities.name: Mirror Reflection of Doom

_curatorNotes: gcsim internal/characters/mona/skill.go Skill(): the DoT AttackInfo (Abil "Mirror Reflection of Doom (Tick)") is Mult: skillDot[c.TalentLvlSkill()], Element Hydro, Durability 25, ICDTag ICDTagElementalArt / ICDGroupDefault; loop `for i := skillHitmarks[hold]; i < 300; i += 59` gives 4 ticks at 86/145/204/263 (tap).
interval 59f / 60 = 0.983s. firstTickDelay = (86 observed first frame − 86 authored spawnsAt) / 60 = 0 — the summon spawns ON its first tick.
scaling 57.6 = skillDot[9] (0.576) in zz_mona.dm.go, cross-checked against docs/curation/talents/mona.json talents.skill row "DoT" 10th value 57.6%.
No icdGate: ICDTagElementalArt/ICDGroupDefault is standard ICD, and the gcsim-frames-diff row verdict is 2/4 `standard`.
Snapshot is c.Snapshot(&ai) with no stat substitution, so stat is atk.

⚠️ TICK-COUNT DIVERGENCE (verifier, 2026-08-17), geometry left alone: our series is bounded by the authored duration, not by a count. spawn 86f + duration 4s = end 326f, so collectSummonTicks emits 86/145/204/263/322 — FIVE ticks, one more than gcsim's four (its loop caps at `i < 300`, so 322 is out). Hold is the same shape (101/160/219/278/337 vs four). The extra tick is an OVER-count: one hydro application at ~5.37s that gcsim never produces. No honest in-schema fix exists — the schema has no tick cap; a duration of 2.95–3.93s would exclude the 5th tick but contradicts the ~4.05s lifetime the explosion measures; a firstTickDelay of 0.067 (4f) yields exactly four ticks at the cost of misstating the first tick's frame. Same class as the documented divergence on Collei's Trump-Card Kitty (an under-count there). Closing it needs a schema-level tick cap.

tickCap 4 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim skill.go `for i := skillHitmarks[hold]; i < 300; i += 59` - a FRAME bound of 300 against a summon whose measured lifetime is ~4.05s, which is why the cap is a count and not a shortened duration. This closes the TICK-COUNT DIVERGENCE noted above, which asked for exactly this field. Both press and hold give 4; unchanged at C6.
Phantom summon spawns at first DoT tick (Tap E: frame 86, Hold E: frame 101) and explodes at skillHitmarks[hold]+243 frames (~4.05s after spawn). Duration rounded to 4s.
Hold E variant (skillFrames[1]): swap=73, Q=58, D=66, J=59; spawnsAt=101 — overrides summons[0].spawnsAt via variant.summons.

Phantom DoT ticks every 59 frames, 4 ticks total — authored as a summonTick damage effect on summons[0] (and restated on the Hold variant's summon, whose array replaces this one). The explosion at skillHitmarks[hold]+243 frames is the ability's own application[] entry (frame 329 tap / 344 hold) and is NOT part of the tick series; its damage (skill[9] = 239.04%) is still unauthored.
A1 auto-Phantom during dash (50% explosion DMG, 2s duration after 2s of dash) not modeled — requires complex dash-duration trigger not covered in this pass.
Same series as the tap-E Phantom — restated because a variant's `summons` REPLACE the base ability's rather than merging, so omitting it would silently drop the DoT on hold E.
gcsim skill.go: the tick loop is `for i := skillHitmarks[hold]; i < 300; i += 59` with skillHitmarks[1] = 101, giving 4 ticks at 101/160/219/278. firstTickDelay = (101 − 101 spawnsAt) / 60 = 0.

⚠️ Same tick-count divergence as the tap Phantom — see the note on summons[0] of the base ability. Duration 4s from spawn 101f ends at 341f, so we emit a fifth tick at 337f that gcsim's `i < 300` cap excludes.

tickCap 4 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim skill.go `for i := skillHitmarks[hold]; i < 300; i += 59` - a FRAME bound of 300 against a summon whose measured lifetime is ~4.05s, which is why the cap is a count and not a shortened duration. This closes the TICK-COUNT DIVERGENCE noted above, which asked for exactly this field. Both press and hold give 4; unchanged at C6.

abilities.description:
Creates an illusory Phantom of Fate from coalesced waterspouts.

Phantom
Has the following special properties:
·Continuously taunts nearby opponents, attracting their fire.
·Continuously deals Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.

abilities.name: Stellaris Phantasm
_curatorNotes: Burst applies Illusory Bubble to enemies at burstHitmark=107 frames (1.78s from cast). Bubble lasts up to 8s (481 frames); on any hit with impulse, bubble pops early and Omen debuff starts for ~5s. The previous variants[]-as-phases curation (Bubble:8 / Omen:5) was a workaround — replaced by a single Illusory Bubble summon here.

Omen window as a rendered summon phase is NOT modeled — that would require Summon.terminatesOn:{type:'trigger',...} for the hit-with-impulse pop plus a sequential-spawn semantic (Omen begins where Bubble ends), both deferred schema work. The team DMG bonus is instead authored as a cast-anchored 5s buff (see next note).

Omen team DMG bonus authored 2026-07-28 (capability sweep): gcsim mona/burst.go:90-109 burstDamageBonus() adds an AttackMod granting DmgP=dmgBonus[TalentLvlBurst] to EVERY party member while the target carries the Illusory Bubble or Omen status; mona_gen.go:186-203 dmgBonus[9]=0.6 (TL10 = 60%), mona_gen.go:222-239 omenDuration[9]=5s. Authored as onCast team allDmgBonus 60, duration 5 — a cast-anchored approximation of the pop-anchored window; the single-enemy scope (bubbled target only) is stated in the caveat.
Bubble does not pop on NoImpulse hits or from freeze-breaking logic (complex conditional in triggerBubbleBurst); caveat for reviewer.
Mobility is omitted because Bubble is enemy-attached (neither 'stationary' nor 'follows' the caster). Acceptable as undefined per current schema.

Hexerei (permanent patch, bare IsHexerei): gcsim burst.go:149-151 — when the Bubble pops, the Omen status is tagged with a refresh budget of 4, enabling the Secret-Rite Omen extension (asc.go:110-156, count-gated at >=2). burst.go:61-63 also opens a 5s post-burst window that guarantees the next C2 follow-up Charged Attack. Neither changes the authored 5s team allDmgBonus window; the extension is caveated on the normal-attack ability and the CA proc on C2. The 5s buff duration was NOT lengthened — the extension is count-gated and per-hit, so faking a longer fixed window would over-credit.
abilities.description:
Mona summons the sparkling waves and creates a reflection of the starry sky, applying the Illusory Bubble status to opponents in a large AoE.

Illusory Bubble
Traps opponents inside a pocket of destiny and also makes them Wet. Renders weaker opponents immobile.
When an opponent affected by Illusory Bubble sustains DMG, it has the following effects:
·Applies an Omen to the opponent, which gives a DMG Bonus, also increasing the DMG of the attack that causes it.
·Removes the Illusory Bubble, dealing Hydro DMG in the process.

Omen
During its duration, increases DMG taken by opponents.
abilities.caveat: The team DMG bonus applies only against the enemy caught in the Illusory Bubble. In game its 5s Omen countdown starts when the bubble bursts from a hit, a beat later than shown.

After she has used Illusory Torrent for 2s, if there are any opponents nearby, Mona will automatically create a Phantom.

constellations.name: Prophecy of Submersion
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. C1 grants reaction bonuses for 8s when any party member hits an Omen-affected enemy: Electro-Charged DMG +15%, Vaporize DMG +15%, Hydro Swirl DMG +15%, Frozen duration +15% (bugged in gcsim), Lunar-Charged +15%, Lunar-Crystallize +15%. Complex trigger (onEnemyDamage with bubble/omen status check). Reviewer to decide target model and whether reaction-type bonuses need a new Effect type.

Hexerei (permanent patch, bare IsHexerei): gcsim cons.go:63-68 multiplies the bonus by 1.6 when the triggering party member is NOT the on-field character, i.e. 15% -> 24% for off-field triggers. Still unauthorable for the same reason the base C1 is (no reaction-DMG-bonus stat; reaction-DMG derivation is FROZEN per caveat-style-guide). Caveated, not modeled.
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the Hydro reaction DMG bonuses from hitting an Omen-affected enemy, including the stronger version off-field members get in a Hexerei party.
constellations.description:
When any of your own party members hits an opponent affected by an Omen, the effects of Hydro-related Elemental Reactions are enhanced for 8s:
· Electro-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Vaporize DMG increases by 15%, Hydro Swirl DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Crystallize DMG increases by 15%.
· Frozen duration is extended by 15%.

constellations.name: Lunar Chain
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. C2 auto-follows 20% of Normal Attack hits with a free Charged Attack (5s ICD, 0.7s delay after N hit). Proc mechanic not modeled in this schema.

Hexerei (permanent patch, bare IsHexerei — gcsim cons.go:133-160 c2HexereiCB, wired on charge.go:69): when Mona's Charged Attack hits an enemy, EVERY party member gets +80 EM. Duration authored 12s per Nate's ruling 2026-07-29 (kit text 12s; gcsim's 60*8 frames = 8s is off here — modifier.NewBaseWithHitlag("mona-hexerei-c2-em", 60*8)), refresh-on-reapply. Authored below as an onHit/charged team EM buff; the gate is Cons>=2 (the constellation itself), NOT a Hexerei count check.

Hexerei (permanent patch): burst.go:61-63 opens a 5s post-burst window in which the next Normal Attack that hits is GUARANTEED to trigger the follow-up Charged Attack (cons.go:120-126 bypasses the 20% roll while that status is active). Attack-sequence machinery — not modelable; caveated.
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the automatic follow-up Charged Attacks, including the guaranteed one within 5s of the burst in a Hexerei party.
constellations.description:

This effect can only occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: Prophecy of Oblivion
_curatorNotes: Migrated to passive trigger + target 'team' 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim AddAttackMod permanent (-1 duration); fires on any party member hit on Omen-affected enemy. The Omen-debuff-active gating isn't expressed (it's a per-segment burst-window state we don't model); the chip renders as a permanent +15% CR team buff while Mona is on the team — over-credits non-burst-window time.

Hexerei (permanent patch, bare IsHexerei — gcsim cons.go:180-183 and the lunar-reaction path cons.go:227-229): `if c.IsHexerei && char.IsHexerei` adds CD=0.15 on top of the CR=0.15, i.e. +15% CRIT DMG but ONLY for party members who are themselves Hexerei. Authored as a second team-targeted buff mirroring the existing critRate effect: EffectTarget has no faction-scoped member, so a Hexerei-only recipient set is inexpressible. This over-credits non-Hexerei teammates — stated in the caveat alongside the pre-existing Omen-gating over-credit. A `teamFaction hexerei min 2` condition IS attached even though gcsim has no count check: the recipient must be Hexerei and the holder is Hexerei, so >=2 Hexerei is strictly implied by the game gate. It narrows the over-credit without asserting anything gcsim does not. The effect still lives on the constellation (a permanent patch), not in factionBonuses.
constellations.caveat: Both CRIT bonuses apply only while the enemy carries an Omen, and the CRIT DMG only reaches Hexerei party members. Both are shown as always on.
constellations.description: When any party member attacks an opponent affected by an Omen, their CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

constellations.name: Rhetorics of Calamitas
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: fixed effect 1 stat 'atk%' → 'allDmgBonus' (gcsim uses DmgP, not ATK%) and deleted effect 2 (allDmgBonus 180, the 3-stack cap misrepresented as a separate flat buff). Per-stack value 60 is preserved on the remaining effect; stacks (max 3 = 180% cap, reset on CA use or after 8s) are not yet modelled — reviewer to wire as stacking/ramping CA DMG bonus, triggered by Illusory Torrent (dash) entry. Trigger remains manual.

Hexerei (permanent patch, bare IsHexerei — gcsim cons.go:260-283 c6HexInit): (a) Charged Attacks that hit an enemy carrying Omen or Illusory Bubble have their multiplier doubled (`atk.Info.Mult *= 2`) — a pure self-damage multiplier, so per the curation contract it is recorded here and caveated, never authored as an effect. (b) c6NearbyOmenTicker (cons.go:324-352) keeps the stack ticker alive whenever an Omen/Bubble enemy is within 15 units, so stacks no longer require an active Illusory Torrent dash to keep ticking (stacks still only accrue while Mona is on field). Both are self-facing damage/stack machinery — no team capability impact.
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the Charged Attack DMG bonus, 60% per second of movement up to 3 stacks. Also not modeled: in a Hexerei party, Charged Attacks deal double DMG to enemies carrying an Omen.
constellations.description:
Upon entering Illusory Torrent, Mona gains a 60% increase to the DMG of her next Charged Attack per second of movement.
A maximum DMG Bonus of 180% can be achieved in this manner. The effect lasts for no more than 8s.
